opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access/research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with public access. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating accredited museums/galleries holding permanent collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities working with disability; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment helping people with disabilities live more independently, especially training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care/services for older people; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating accredited libraries/archives caring for nationally significant collections with public access. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts as the vast majority of its activities. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally building/refurbishment and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally refurbishing/creating galleries and education spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority running special schools/colleges for children and young people with special educational needs; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level with special educational needs to develop skills for employment or independent living. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant £15,000; maximum grant £100,000; usual range £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build/refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above inspection rating.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of GCSE/A-Level subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). 2026 round closed; next round details expected spring 2027.
